coverage.reason: Ihold (1.50A), Itrip (3.00A), Vmax (16 Vdc), Imax (40A), Pd typ (1.0W), time-to-trip (0.30s at 8.00A), Rmin (0.025 ohm), and R1max (0.130 ohm) are all primary-source confirmed from the BHFUSE BSMD1206 Series Electrical Characteristics (25C) table, row BSMD1206-150-16V.

Ambient operating range (-40 to +85C), maximum tripped-state surface temperature (125C), 85C-ambient derated hold current (0.77A), and qualitative aging/thermal-shock/repeated-trip resistance-change data are all primary-source confirmed from the same datasheet's Environmental Specifications and Thermal Derating Chart tables.

Ihold leaves a 0.7A margin above the -12V/0.8A rail current budget magnitude and Vmax leaves a 4V margin above the 12V nominal rail voltage magnitude; both are positive but the voltage margin (33% headroom) is the tightest of board-b's three PTCs and does not account for switching-rail ripple or transients upstream of the LDO.

No board-b generator spec exists yet to bound upstream fault current/energy at PTC3, in-enclosure ambient temperature, local heat sources, expected trip count over product life, or the cooling interval between faults.
